feature_flags.purpose: Enable future agent runtime after a dedicated approved runtime stage.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Policy gate and owner approval required before promotion from OFF.
feature_flags.rollback: Set AGENT_RUNTIME=OFF and revoke active approvals.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no runtime installed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future read-only MCP/tool access through gateway.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Policy gate plus owner approval before production read adapters.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no MCP server installed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future write-capable tools only after strong gates; explicitly off here.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Strong owner approval required in later stage.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no MCP server installed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable long-term memory writes after curator, audit, and owner approval.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Policy gate and owner approval required before promotion.
feature_flags.rollback: Set MEMORY_WRITE=OFF and block memory commits.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no memory writes enabled in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future knowledge ingestion after data classification and source approval.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Owner approval required before external or scheduled ingest.
feature_flags.rollback: Set KNOWLEDGE_INGEST=OFF and stop ingestion jobs.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no ingest jobs created in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future commercial draft generation without sending.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Policy gate before activation; sends remain R4 owner approval.
feature_flags.rollback: Set COMMERCIAL_DRAFT=OFF and hide draft actions.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no draft runtime enabled in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future email sends only after owner approval; off by default.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Owner approval required per payload hash; STOP sets OUTBOUND_OFF.
feature_flags.rollback: Set OUTBOUND_EMAIL=OFF and revoke send approvals.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no sends performed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future social publishing only after owner approval; off by default.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Owner approval required per payload hash; STOP sets OUTBOUND_OFF.
feature_flags.rollback: Set OUTBOUND_SOCIAL=OFF and revoke publish approvals.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no publishes performed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future production deployments after owner-approved release stage.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Owner approval required; not eligible in foundation.
feature_flags.rollback: Set PRODUCTION_DEPLOY=OFF and execute approved deployment rollback if later used.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no deploy performed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future production database writes after owner-approved data stage.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Owner approval required; not eligible in foundation.
feature_flags.rollback: Set PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE=OFF and execute approved DB rollback if later used.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no production DB writes performed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future payment or purchase actions only after strong owner approval.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Strong owner approval required; not eligible in foundation.
feature_flags.rollback: Set PAYMENTS=OFF and revoke active approvals.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no payments performed in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future push-to-talk only; no always-on listening and no voice payments.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Policy gate required; risky actions require screen confirmation.
feature_flags.rollback: Set VOICE=OFF and disable voice entry points.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no voice runtime enabled in foundation.

feature_flags.purpose: Enable future limited autonomy only for explicitly safe, reversible, low-risk actions.
feature_flags.approval_requirement: Policy gate and owner-approved allowlist required; no R4/R5 autonomy.
feature_flags.rollback: Set AUTO_SAFE=OFF and revoke active automation approvals.
feature_flags.rollback_note: Set flag OFF; no autonomy enabled in foundation.
